en: Tinted night view of a central boulevard in a large city, with tram tracks and streetlights running down the middle, cars and pedestrians along the sidewalks, and mid‑rise interwar buildings with illuminated windows and signage (including a rooftop sign reading "CREDITUL MINIER"). The border is scalloped. Caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Brătianu Boulevard at night in Bucharest. The reverse side reads "ROMÂNIA CARTĂ POSTALĂ" and lists the publisher.
